program.section_heading: Theatre Arts Associate in Arts for Transfer
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to recognize, describe, and effectively produce various components of a performing art form.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to analyze the ways in which arts reflect historical, intellectual, and cultural contexts, as well as aesthetic tastes.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply acquired skills and knowledge, through successful group or individual performance, appropriate to a particular performing art form.
